## Description
RCA/Whirlpool's Miracle Kitchen, shown at the 1959 American National Exhibition in Moscow, featured a robot floor cleaner, a dishwasher that rolled to the table, push-button controls and a home planning centre. The robot and the dishwasher were not automatic: a person behind a two-way mirror operated them by radio.
